claim: The published D18/PY-IT/eC9 anchor device is lab-scale fabrication evidence and does not by itself validate the project's 1 cm^2 to 10 cm^2 manufacturing-transfer stage.

source.title: Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface

methods_facts.active_layer_method: spin coating at 2000-2500 rpm for 30 s

project_reference_areas.provenance: research/session-history.md v1.3 scale-transfer program; engineering targets, not literature thresholds

uncertainty.note: No physical area uncertainty is reported in the inspected Methods text; none is invented. Calculations use the published nominal areas exactly as reported.

validity_domain: Evidence classification for scale/manufacturing transfer only; not a statement about intrinsic efficiency, mechanism, or whether scale-up will fail.
falsifier: Public primary-source evidence showing the same D18/PY-IT/eC9 architecture/process and claimed effect on provenance-complete >=1 cm^2 devices would retire or narrow this lab-scale-only classification.
